images.name: horse-1
images.prompt: Paint: a wide empty plain at early dawn on the edge of hills near a city; a single saddled horse stands alone without its rider, its saddle covered with a deep red woven cloth; a little behind it, a set of pale robes lies on the ground, folded upright as if still holding a shape; long soft morning shadows, mist on the ground, a sense of quiet mystery. No people at all.

images.name: hero-1
images.prompt: Paint: green coastal mountains rising above a Mediterranean shore in bright clear morning light; a small stone village with flat roofs terraced on the slopes; olive trees; red woven cloths drying on a line on a rooftop in the foreground; the sea glimmering in the distance. images.name: village-1
images.prompt: Paint: a lone stone house on a mountain slope at dusk; warm lamplight glows in one small window; a red curtain is visible inside the window; a narrow path leads to a wooden door; quiet hills behind under a soft purple-gold sky. No people visible.

images.name: cairo-1

images.name: lebanon-1
images.prompt: Paint: Mount Lebanon — steep green terraced slopes, a stone mountain village with one house roofed in red clay tiles in the foreground, cedar and pine trees, a snow-capped ridge far in the distance, bright clear midday light.

images.name: midian-1
images.prompt: Paint: an ancient stone well in a wide desert valley of Midian at golden afternoon, red sandstone cliffs behind, a few sheep resting by stone troughs, a deep red woven cloth draped over the edge of the well; one small shepherd far away, seen from behind.

images.name: fields-1
images.prompt: Paint: poor terraced farm fields on the slopes of coastal mountains in Syria in early morning, a humble stone-and-mud farmhouse, a wooden plough left in a furrow, a red cloth bundle on a low stone wall; one small farmer far away bent over the soil, seen from behind.

images.name: port-1
images.prompt: Paint: the small old harbour of a Levantine coastal town in the early twentieth century, bright morning, an anchored steamship and wooden fishing boats, stone warehouses with red-tiled roofs and a red awning; tiny distant figures on the quay seen from behind; no flags.

images.name: damascus-1
images.prompt: Paint: the old city of Damascus seen from a hillside in warm late afternoon, a dense sea of flat roofs, domes and minarets, a bare mountain behind; a red carpet hung over a rooftop rail in the foreground. No people.

images.name: suwayda-1
images.prompt: Paint: a village of dark basalt stone houses on a volcanic hill in southern Syria, bright clear morning, stone walls between small orchards and vineyards, a red wooden door and a red cloth drying on a flat roof, wide sky. No people.
